name: dispatch-ghl
description: Dispatch: Grok Bot skills + HighLevel MCP for home-service companies (roofing, fencing, gutters, screen enclosures, tree service, restoration — trade packs). Storm-surge intake, triage, estimates, claims, permits, follow-up — and day-to-day ops after the storm.

DISPATCH_KEY.title: Dispatch gateway key
DISPATCH_KEY.description: The Dispatch platform key (DISPATCH_INTERNAL_KEY). The gateway swaps it for a HighLevel token per request; the bot never holds a HighLevel token. Same key for every sub-account.

GHL_LOCATION_ID.title: HighLevel Location (sub-account) ID
GHL_LOCATION_ID.description: The sub-account this plugin install is bound to. One install per contractor sub-account. The agency's Dispatch marketplace install must cover it (automatic for sub-accounts created from the snapshot).
